column3: MT 2:2. NKJV spells חוּרָם as “Hiram,” and completes the comparison with “so deal with me,” which the Hebrew leaves unstated.
MT 2:10. Close to the Hebrew; NKJV spells “Huram” as “Hiram.”
MT 2:11. Close to the Hebrew; NKJV spells “Huram” as “Hiram.”
MT 2:12. NKJV renders אָבִי (part of the name “Huram-abi,” or “my father”) as “my master craftsman.”
